MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement (“Agreement") is entered into as of 16th January, 2019 (the "Effective Date"), by and between Mindtree Limited, a company incorporated under the laws of India, and having its registered office at Global Village, RVCE Post, Mysore Road, Bangalore, 560059, Karnataka, India together with its Affiliates referred to as "Mindtree", which expression shall mean and include where the context so requires or admits its permissible successors and assigns.
And

Franklin Madison Group LLC, a limited liability company organized under the laws of Delaware and validly existing, having its principal place of business at 801 Crescent Centre Drive, Suite 500, Franklin TN 37067 (which term includes its, permitted assigns and successors in business and hereinafter collectively referred to as "Client).
Mindtree and Client shall hereinafter be referred to collectively as the "Parties," and individually as a "Party."
WHEREAS:

A. Mindtree is a provider of information technology services and is engaged interalia in the business of providing services in relation to digital, testing, infrastructure management and technical support, knowledge services, product engineering, which comprises of R&D services, software product engineering etc.
B. Client desires that Mindtree provide certain information technology services to Client, on the terms and conditions set forth below and as defined in the respective Statement(s) of Work.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing recitals, of the mutual terms and conditions of this Agreement, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and adequacy of which are acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows:
1. DEFINITIONS

When used in this Agreement or in each Statement of Work, the capitalized terms listed in this section shall have the meaning as provided below. Other capitalized terms used in this Agreement shall have the meaning respectively assigned to them elsewhere in this Agreement or in each Statement of Work.
1.1 "Agreement" means this Master Services Agreement, its schedules, exhibits, and each Statement of Work together with all amendments as approved in writing by the Parties from time to time.

1.2 "Affiliate" means entities that control, are controlled by or are under common control with a Party to this Agreement. For the purpose of the foregoing "control" (including, "controlled by" and "under common control with") as used with respect to any entities shall mean ownership of more than fifty percent (50%) of the stock or other equity interests entitled to vote for the election of the directors or an equivalent governing body, control over the board of directors or an equivalent governing body.
1.3 "Change Order" means documents evidencing an agreement of the Parties to a change of the SOW, which is signed or otherwise agreed in writing by both Parties.

1.4 "Client Sites" mean the sites, locations or premises that is owned, controlled or occupied by Client, its Affiliates or their customers in relation to providing the Deliverables and/or performance of the Services pursuant to this Agreement.

1.5 "Deliverable" or "Deliverables" means all software, code, programs, documentation and other works of authorship that Mindtree creates, develops or modifies pursuant to Specifications under a Statement of Work for the Client excluding Mindtree Background Technology and/ or third party Intellectual Property Rights.

1.6 “Intellectual Property Rights" means any: (a) formulae, algorithms, methodologies, processes, process, code, diagrams, scripts, automations, schema, improvements, procedures, designs, ideas, concepts, research, discoveries, work product, materials, inventions and invention disclosures (whether or not patentable or reduced to practice), know-how, and technology; (b) software, databases, tools, and machine-readable texts and files; and (c) literary work or other work of authorship, including all documentation, together with all patents, copyrights, trademarks, service marks, trade secrets and other intellectual property rights in or appurtenant to any of the foregoing subsections (a) through (c).
1.7 "Services" means as any and all work to be performed by the Mindtree as per the Specifications in the SOW.

1.8 "Specifications" means the specifications as to its intended functionality and features, with reference to Services, a description or type of Services and as agreed by the Parties in the relevant Statement of Work.
1.9 "Statement(s) of Work” or “SOW" means the exhibit attached hereto, specifying the Services and/or Deliverables in respect of any specific project to be provided by Mindtree to the Client.
1.10 “Third Party Software" means any Intellectual Property Rights of third party which is not owned by Client or Mindtree.
2. SERVICES & DELIVERABLES

This Agreement serves as the framework under which the Parties shall enter into separate statements of work for services and, if applicable, deliverables (each, a “Statement of Work” or “SOW”) in the form attached hereto as Exhibit B. Unless otherwise agreed by the Parties in writing, all SOWs that are entered into under this Agreement shall be governed by the terms of this Agreement and are hereby made part of and incorporated into this Agreement. In the event of a conflict between this Agreement and a SOW, the terms of this Agreement shall prevail, unless the SOW expressly references the specific provision in this Agreement to be modified by the SOW. This Agreement and SOWs under this Agreement shall constitute the complete agreement between the parties regarding the subject matter and supersedes any prior oral or written communication including any pre-sales proposals.

For the avoidance of doubt, any and all of the Client's standard Purchase Order (“PO”) terms, which may be found in a Statement of Work, PO document or any other related document, shall have no applicability and Mindtree's acceptance of such PO terms shall be limited to invoicing purpose only.
2.1 Projects with Deliverable responsibility
Mindtree agrees to provide Services as per the Specifications agreed to in a Statement of Work, subject to the following terms and conditions:
Such Services can be of two (2) types of projects:
(a) Fixed Price Project: Such project are for a fixed fee and under which the project is controlled and or managed by Mindtree and the Deliverables are specified in the relevant Statement of Work;
(b) Time & Material Projects: Such projects are for man month fees, wherein Mindtree utilizes its personnel to provide Services on an effort basis.

2.1.1 Acceptance of Deliverables. All Deliverables shall be subject to acceptance process as agreed in the SOW. Deliverables shall be deemed accepted if Client neither accepts or rejects within 14 ( fourteen) days following the delivery of the Deliverable.

2.1.2 Rejection of Deliverables and Exclusive Remedies - In the event of rejection of the Deliverables, Mindtree shall either utilize commercially reasonable efforts to correct the specified deficiencies or non- conformities, or provide Client with a remedial action plan, including a time frame for completion of the corrected Deliverables which shall not exceed twenty-one (21) days from the time of Mindtree's response to a notice of rejection or such other mutually agreed period. In the event that Mindtree fails to correct the rejected Deliverable within the time period specified in this paragraph, the Client may, at its option, terminate the relevant Statement of Work with no further cure period and Mindtree shall return such proportionate amounts to the Client which has been paid by the Client for the relevant rejected Deliverables. The remedies of this paragraph shall be Client's sole and exclusive remedies for rejection of Deliverables and are contingent upon Client's performance of all obligations required by this Agreement.
2.2 Change Order. The Parties may modify the scope of work through a Change Order. The Parties shall in good faith discuss and mutually agree on a Change Order
3. CLIENT OBLIGATION AND RELIANCE ON INPUTS

3.1 Client at its cost shall provide Mindtree with all information, documents, tools, designs, materials, non- standard hardware and software, directions, instructions, specifications, functional requirements, specific software requirements and guidance access with appropriate rights as specified in a Statement of Work ("Inputs") that may be reasonably necessary for Mindtree's performance of the Services or delivery of Deliverables. The parties acknowledge that Mindtree's performance of Services or delivery of Deliverables under this Agreement shall be predicated upon the Inputs provided by Client. Mindtree shall be relieved from its responsibility for delay or failure to provide the Services or the Deliverables to Client and/or any third party as per this Agreement, for any delay or failure to provide any Inputs by the Client or any third party engaged by Client.

3.2 In order to allow Mindtree to perform its obligations under this Agreement, Client shall be responsible for ensuring that its facilities are accessible and supported during normal business hours, Client's equipment is operational for the purposes of meeting the obligations contained within this Agreement, and Mindtree personnel is provided with workstations that have access to such Equipment, log-on ID's, disk space, printer access, phones and work space as is reasonably necessary to complete the Services or deliver the Deliverables during the project. For purposes of this Agreement, equipment ("Equipment") shall mean any computer hardware or Third Party Software or tools necessary to properly run the licensed programs, materials, hardware or Inputs. Mindtree personnel shall observe all safety and other applicable rules in effect at such Client Sites, provided that reasonable notice of the rules has been supplied to Mindtree and to such personnel in writing.

3.3 If Mindtree's employees, subcontractors or agents are requested or required to render services on Client Sites, Client warrants and covenants' that it shall provide a safe and secure workplace at all Client Sites, which meets or exceeds the generally acceptable standards which are consistent with that of the law of land, its own employees, and those relevant in the same industry, together with all relevant infrastructure and access to Client's personnel necessary for the delivery of Deliverables and the performance of Services. Client shall be liable and legally responsible and shall indemnify Mindtree for any injury that maybe caused to Mindtree's employees, subcontractors or agents, including death, while delivering Deliverables or performing Services at Client Sites, provided that the same is not primarily due to the willful misconduct of Mindtree's employees, subcontractors or agents.
4. CHARGES, INVOICING AND PAYMENT & DISPUTED CHARGES

Client warrants to pay Mindtree the amounts as per the terms, at the times and in the manner as set forth in this Agreement or Statements of Work. Additionally, Client shall pay, but only to the extent specifically approved in writing by Client, (i) Mindtree's reasonable out-of-pocket expenses incurred as a result of Mindtree's performance of Services or delivery of Deliverables (i.e., travel and lodging costs - See Exhibit A); and (ii) all taxes, including without limitation, sales, service, use, excise, or value-added taxes, other than franchise or income tax, based upon or measured by the charges as set forth in this Agreement, or based upon any Deliverables or Services provided.

Time is of the essence with respect to payment of Mindtree's invoices and it is an essential condition to this Agreement. Unless otherwise specified in the Statement of Work, invoices shall be issued monthly by Mindtree. Payment is due within thirty (30) calendar days of the invoice's date ("Due Date"). In the event that a payment is not made within that thirty (30) calendar day period, Mindtree reserves the right to (i) levy a delayed payment charge of one percent (1%) per month on the invoiced amount until the date Client remits payment in full and/ or (ii) suspend the Services under the affected Statement of Work and/or (iii) not create and deliver the Deliverables.

The rates hereby set forth shall be valid for a period of 1 year from the effective date of this Agreement, after which the parties shall negotiate in good faith a rate revision, provided however that the rates that govern an SOW will be valid for the remainder of the SOW unless otherwise provided therein.

In the event Client requires any Mindtree personnel to expend hours more than legally mandated work hours requiring overtime then Client shall compensate Mindtree, to compensate employees according to local law. For Mindtree personnel with non-exempt status, the overtime bill rate will be calculated 1.5 times the straight time billing rate stipulated in the rate card.
5. OWNERSHIP AND USE OF INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS

5.1 Conveyance of Intellectual Property Rights. Unless otherwise agreed between the parties in a SOW, Client shall own the rights, title and interest in and to all Intellectual Property Rights for all Deliverables only upon Client's payment in full to Mindtree for all amounts due to Mindtree for such Deliverables.

5.2 Reservation of Rights. Notwithstanding the preceding paragraph, Client acknowledges and agrees that the execution of the Services and/or delivery of Deliverables will involve the use by Mindtree of its Intellectual Property Rights which are pre-existing at the date of this Agreement or which are subsequently brought into existence independently by Mindtree other than as a result of the performance under this Agreement (“Mindtree Background Technology”). To the extent that Mindtree Background Technology are present in the Deliverables, Mindtree shall grant to Client a license to Mindtree Background Technology to be used not on a stand-alone basis and to be mutually agreed upon in the SOW.

5.3 Residual Rights. Either party shall be free to use the residuals resulting from access to or work with the other party's Confidential Information for any purpose; however, the Receiving Party shall not disclose the Confidential Information except as permitted pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. The term "residuals" shall mean information in intangible form only, retained in the memory of persons employed or retained, by the Receiving Party, who have had access to or worked with the Confidential Information, including ideas, concepts, know-how or techniques contained therein, but which are not the result of a conscious or concerted effort to memorize or retain the same in memory by any person.

5.4 Client Grant. Client at its cost grants to Mindtree the right to access, operate, use, and modify any software, systems, Inputs provided or utilized by Client including without limitation, computer programs, supporting documentation for such programs, and tangible media upon which such programs are recorded, without charge to Mindtree, as Mindtree reasonably deems appropriate to execute the Services or deliver the Deliverables. Client at its cost shall obtain all necessary licenses or approval from third parties to permit Mindtree to access, operate, use, and modify such systems or Inputs pursuant to this Agreement. Client warrants that it owns or has holds title to appropriate licenses or approvals for all assets, hardware, software or tools, assets and Inputs that Client provides to Mindtree for the performance of Services or Deliverables and shall indemnify and hold harmless Mindtree, its Affiliates from breach of this Agreement.
5.5 Open Source Software and Third Party Software Disclaimer

Client may procure the license of any Open Source Software (OSS) or Third Party Software from third parties for the purpose of enabling Mindtree to create Deliverables as per this Agreement or the relevant SOW. Mindtree shall use such OSS or Third Party Software as an agent of and under the instructions and authorizations of the Client. The Client shall be solely responsible for compliance of all terms and conditions of the OSS or the Third Party Software. Deliverables created entirely or partially based on such Third Party Software or OSS shall be subject to the terms and conditions set forth by the respective licensing terms. Mindtree does not provide any warranty, representations or indemnity on the Deliverables developed using such OSS or Third Party Software. Client hereby releases Mindtree from any claims, obligation or liabilities or arising out of any use of such Third Party Software or OSS. Client shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Mindtree from and against any damages, costs, liabilities, or expenses ("Claim") brought by third party against Mindtree to the extent such Claim arises out of Mindtree's use of or breach of such OSS or Third Party Software licensing terms.
6. CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS

For the purpose of this Agreement, the Party disclosing Confidential Information shall be referred to as the "Disclosing Party” and the Party receiving Confidential Information shall be referred to as the "Receiving Party". The term “Confidential Information” as used herein shall mean any and all information and material that may be disclosed by the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party in the course of this Agreement in written or otherwise tangible form which could reasonably be considered confidential or proprietary whether or not such is clearly marked “Confidential” or “Proprietary”. Any oral or otherwise non-tangible disclosure shall not be considered Confidential Information unless it is (a) identified as "Confidential” by the Disclosing Party at the time of disclosure and (b) summarized in writing (in the English language) and marked as "Confidential" or "Proprietary", provided that the Receiving Party receives the summary within fifteen (15) business days after such disclosure. During the pendency of the above stated fifteen (15) business day period, any oral or otherwise non-tangible disclosure shall be protected in accordance with the terms of this Agreement.

Confidential Information shall not be used by the Receiving Party other than for the purposes under this Agreement for which the Confidential Information was disclosed. The Receiving Party shall have the right to divulge the Confidential Information to its employees, Affiliates, consultants and agents on a need to know basis, who shall be bound by the confidentiality obligations specified in this Agreement to the same extent as that of the Receiving Party and Receiving Party is responsible for all acts or omissions of such employees, Affiliates, consultants and agents. The Receiving Party shall protect such Confidential Information from disclosure to third parties and shall hold it as confidential using the same degree of care as it uses to protect its own confidential or proprietary material of like importance. The confidentiality obligations specified in this Agreement shall continue for a period of five (5) years from the termination or expiration of this Agreement.
The confidentiality obligations specified in this Agreement shall not apply to any Confidential Information which:
(a) is generally available to the public;
(b) is in the Receiving Party's possession prior to receiving it;
(c) is lawfully disclosed to the Receiving Party by a third party who to the best of Receiving Party's knowledge does not bear a confidentiality obligation to the other party;
(d) was independently developed by the Receiving Party without use of the Confidential Information;
(e) is disclosed by the Receiving Party with the Disclosing Party's prior approval in writing.
(f) is required to be disclosed by law, court order, governmental authority, regulation of any recognized stock exchange or any other competent authority;

The Receiving Party shall (i) promptly notify the Disclosing Party to the extent lawful and practical to enable the Disclosing Party to protect its Confidential Information, (ii) at the request and sole expense of the Disclosing Party, cooperate reasonably with the Disclosing Party's efforts to contest or limit the scope of the order or directive and (iii) limit any disclosure to the minimum that is necessary to comply with the regulation, order or directive.
7. NON HIRING

Each Party agrees that during the term of this Agreement and for a period of one (1) years thereafter, it shall not directly or indirectly solicit, attempt to solicit or induce, hire, recruit or otherwise cause an employee or consultant of the one party to terminate his or her employment, contractual or other relationship with the other party in order to become an employee or consultant to or for Mindtree or Client. For the purpose of the foregoing, employee or consultant shall mean any person who is presently employed or engaged by either Party or was employed or engaged by either Party in the immediately twelve (12) months preceding the solicitation or attempt to hire or hiring.
8. WARRANTY
8.1 Mindtree's Warranty for Deliverables

Unless otherwise agreed in the SOW, Mindtree warrants that, for a period of thirty (30) calendar days or any other period as mutually agreed in a SOW from the date of delivery of the Deliverables under a Statement of Work, it shall use its commercially reasonable efforts to correct any material defects in the Deliverables delivered or accepted under a Statement of Work at no additional charge to Client and within a reasonable amount of time ("Deliverables Warranty"). For any warranty beyond 30 days, Client shall be liable to pay additional charges as agreed in the SOW.

The Deliverables Warranty shall not cover or include any rework for enhancements or improvements or change made by a third party or Deliverables where Client's payment for the same is in default. The above shall be Client's sole and exclusive remedy for any Deliverables Warranty claim and is contingent upon Client's performance of all its obligations required by this Agreement.
The Deliverables Warranty shall not apply in the following cases:

i. any defect or infringement arises from any modification to the Deliverables by persons other than Mindtree, or to the extent they arise out of the information/material supplied by Client to complete the Deliverables; or
ii. Mindtree's compliance with Client's designs, specifications or instructions; or
iii. Any defect arising from any modification to the Deliverables by persons other than Mindtree after delivery by Mindtree; or
iv. Use by the Client of the Deliverables or portion thereof in combination with any other services/ deliverables not provided by Mindtree; or
v. Improper usage by the Client.
8.2 Waiver of Further Warranty

Except AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH HEREIN, BOTH PARTIES HEREBY DISCLAIM ALL WARRANTIES TO EACH OTHER AND ALL THIRD-PARTIES, WITH RESPECT TO EXPRESS, IMPLIED, STATUTORY WARRANTIES INCLUDING, WITHOUT LIMITATION, WITH RESPECT TO THE SERVICES OR DELIVERABLES (AND ALL PORTION OR COMPONENTS THEREOF), IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, QUALITY, NON-INFRINGEMENT, AND FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

Mindtree does not warrant that the operation of the Deliverables or output of Services will be uninterrupted and/or error-free. all warranties provided herein are personal to, and are intended solely for the benefit of client and do not extend to any third party or to any third party materials or other materials given by Mindtree to client outside this agreement. No warranty is given for any third party hardware, software, materials or tools, etc.
8.3 Other Representations and Warranties of Mindtree

8.3.1 Authority. Subject to the terms of this Agreement, Mindtree has all requisite right and authority to enter into this Agreement and perform all Services or deliver the Deliverables called for by each Statement of Work and that it is has been validly authorized and constitutes a legally binding and enforceable obligation.
8.3.2 Representations and Warranties of Client.

8.3.2.1 Authority. Each person executing this Agreement on behalf of Client warrants and represents that he or she has authority to sign on behalf of Client and that this Agreement has been validly authorized and constitutes a legally binding and enforceable obligation of Client. Client warrants and agrees that it has the present ability and foreseeable future ability to fulfill all of Client's obligations under this Agreement.

8.3.2.2 Financial Representation of Client. Client warrant, and covenants that it has the present financial resources and foreseeable future financial resources to timely pay all anticipated invoices of Mindtree and Client's other financial obligations under this Agreement and each anticipated Statement of Work. Client agrees to notify Mindtree within five (5) business days if Client believes that it lacks or reasonably anticipates that it will lack such financial resources to fulfill Client's financial obligations under this Agreement and each anticipated Statement of Work.
9. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

9.1 Indirect Damages. The parties mutually agree to waive, to the fullest extent permitted by law, any claim, liability, prayer or recovery of any indirect, incidental, consequential, special, exemplary, punitive, damages, nor for anticipated savings, any lost profits or revenue or business or goodwill loss of or damage to data and third party claims (other than as expressly provided in this agreement) arising out of this agreement (even if such party has been advised of the possibility of such damages, losses, costs or expenses whether based on an action or claim in contract, equity, negligence, tort or any other theory).

9.2. Direct Damages. The parties mutually agree that Mindtree's aggregate liability for direct damages under this Agreement and any relevant Statement of Work shall be limited to the total fees payable by the Client to Mindtree in the preceding six (6) months pursuant to the applicable SOW or Change Order giving rise to the claim. Notwithstanding anything stated to the contrary, nothing in this Agreement limits or excludes a Party's liability for (i) death or personal injury arising out of negligence, (ii) fraud, or (iii) willful misconduct or gross negligence.
10. TERM AND TERMINATION
This Agreement will commence on the Effective Date specified above and, shall remain in effect unless earlier terminated as provided below.
10.1. Termination of Agreement or Statement of Work for cause
Either Party may terminate this Agreement or Statement of Work by providing prior notice in writing to the other and under the following terms:

(i) The defaulting Party defaults on any material obligation established under or pursuant to this Agreement or the Statement of Work and fails to remedy the said default to the non-defaulting Party's reasonable satisfaction within thirty (30) calendar days after written notification of said default; or

(ii) The other Party becomes insolvent or bankrupt, or assigns all or a substantial part of its business or assets for the benefit of creditors, or permits the appointment of a receiver for its business or assets, or becomes subject to any legal proceeding relating to insolvency or the protection of creditors' rights or otherwise ceases to conduct its business in the normal course.
10.2. Termination of Agreement or Statement of Work by Client for Convenience
Client may terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience by providing sixty (60) calendar days prior notice in writing thereof to Mindtree.
10.3. Effect of Termination

Upon any such termination and subject to payment by Client to Mindtree for all such Deliverables and/or Services delivered or performed through the date of termination, Mindtree shall deliver to Client all the Deliverables and/or Services under a Statement of Work regardless of whether such Deliverables and/or Services are completed Mindtree.

In the event of termination under this section, Client shall pay for (i) all the Services and Deliverables provided up to the effective date of termination and (ii) be liable to pay Mindtree for all chargeable and non-cancellable materials, demobilization costs and stranded costs through the date of termination.
11. GOVERNING LAWS AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION

a. Where a Client is incorporated under the laws of the United States of America, the Agreement is governed and construed in accordance with the laws of New York and the parties submit to the jurisdiction of the courts of New York.
b. The United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods shall not apply to this Agreement.
c. JURY TRIAL WAIVER. THE PARTIES WAIVE ALL RIGHTS TO TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY LITIGATION ARISING FROM OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT.
12. MISCELLANEOUS
12.1 Status of Mindtree As Independent Contractor
Mindtree shall be classified as an independent contractor in the performance of this Agreement and shall not be deemed an employee or agent of Client for any purpose whatsoever.

12.2 Notices. Any notice or other communication required or permitted under this Agreement shall be in writing and shall be either (i) given in person, (ii) sent by telex, facsimile or e-mail or (iii) sent by airmail, with postage prepaid, to the address specified below or to any other address that may be designated by a Party by prior written notice.

A notice given will be deemed to have been received: (i) on the date of delivery if hand delivered; or (ii) on the business day on which a transmission is sent via telex, facsimile or e-mail; or (iii) seven business days after the date of posting if sent by pre-paid airmail.

12.3 Force Majeure and Hardship Clause. A Party shall not be liable for any event that is beyond the control of that Party or which could not have been reasonably foreseen, including without limitation, acts of god, man or state, civil unrest, terrorism, explosions, floods, hurricanes, earthquakes, mechanical breakdowns, strikes, labor unrest, breakdown in essential utilities, medical or other emergencies ("Force Majeure").

On the occurrence of an event of Force Majeure, the affected Party shall immediately inform the other Party of the event in writing and shall continue to perform all other obligations unless the prevented obligation is essential to the Agreement. If within a period of thirty (30) calendar days, the Force Majeure event continues, either Party may terminate this Agreement and/or the relevant Statement of Work upon a prior written notice to the other Party as its sole and exclusive remedy. A Force Majeure event shall not relieve Client of its payment obligations for the Deliverables and/or Services commenced or completed by Mindtree.

If, due to a change of circumstances which couldn't have been foreseen upon conclusion of the contract (such as substantial increase in the visas costs or prevailing wage levels notified by the appropriate authority etc.) (herein after defined as "Adverse Impact"), such that performance becomes excessively costly for Mindtree, then Mindtree can pass on to the Client the exact cost of the Adverse Impact, upon Mindtree furnishing reasonable evidence of the same. If the Client refuses such accept the cost of the Adverse Impact, then Mindtree may decide to terminate the Agreement for convenience in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Agreement.

12.4 Waivers. Neither Party shall be deemed, by any act or omission, to have waived any of its rights or remedies hereunder unless such waiver is in writing and signed by the waiving Party, and then only to the extent specifically set forth in such Writing. A waiver with reference to one event will not be construed as continuing or as a bar to or waiver of any right or remedy as to a subsequent event.

12.5 Publicity. Mindtree shall not be entitled to advertise and represent that the Client is a customer of Mindtree and the broad nature of work performed by Mindtree for the Client without the prior written approval of Client in each instance. Mindtree's publicity shall not disclose any Confidential Information. The Parties acknowledge that Mindtree shall not be permitted to use the Client name and logo in its sales presentation in any manner without the prior written approval of Client in each instance.
12.6 Non Assignment. The Parties agree that this Agreement may not be assigned or otherwise transferred to a third party without the prior written consent of the other Party.

12.7 Severability. If any provision or part of this Agreement shall be determined to be illegal, invalid or unenforceable, that part shall be severed from this Agreement and the remaining parts shall be valid and enforceable.

12.8 Counterparts. This Agreement may be executed in two or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which together shall constitute one instrument. An electronic copy of an executed signature page delivered by facsimile transmission or e-mail shall be binding to the same extent as an original copy of an executed signature page delivered otherwise. A Party that delivers an electronic copy of an executed signature page agrees to later deliver an original counterpart to the other Party if requested.

12.9 Headings. The headings used in this Agreement are for convenience and identification only, and shall not be deemed to limit, amplify or define the contents of the respective sections or paragraphs to which they pertain.

12.10 Independent Counsel. Each Party in entering this Agreement has relied upon the advice from their own independent counsel. This Agreement was negotiated and drafted jointly by or on behalf of the Parties to this Agreement, and shall not be interpreted against any Party on the basis that such Party or their attorney drafted any of its provisions.

Mindtree Billing Policy

Mindtree Billing Policy
The following are the standards set by Mindtree:

<u>Hours Worked:</u> All consulting support is billed on a Time and Material basis, unless otherwise set forth in the applicable Statement of Work.

Consultants maintain a daily timesheet of all hours worked with a brief description of the nature of work performed for that day. Hours are logged to the nearest quarter of an hour. A minimum of eight hours (8) hours per day will be charged for onsite consultants and a minimum of eight and three quarters (8.75) hours per day will be charged for offshore consultants. It is Industry standard practice in India (offshore location) to work from 8.30 AM to 6.00 PM Indian Standard Time with a 45 minutes break for lunch and coffee.

If client prefers a monthly billing, onsite resources are billed by Mindtree at 176 hours per month and offshore resources are billed by Mindtree at 192.50 hours per month. Mindtree’s personnel shall be entitled to take two-day leave in a calendar month and there shall be no reduction in billing for the same.
<u>Lunch Time:</u> Clients will not be billed for consultants’ lunch time, unless work or business is conducted during that time.
Mindtree Travel and Expense Policy
The following are the standards set by Mindtree for consultant travel and expenses:
Per Diem: Mindtree will charge $50 per day (pl confirm amt) as per diem to the Client towards breakfast, lunch, dinner and laundry only.

<u>Airfare:</u> Airfare from India to the USA is approximately $2,500.00 roundtrip. If for any reason local air travel or other travel is required within USA the actual costs for such travel will be debited to the Client.
